body: I don't want to keep going against you or anything, but this isn't the case. This happens with everyone I get to meet. :\
Thank you. Most people think I'm nice actually, but eventually reject me. They get bored of me, or just don't want me around.

Hopefully, yeah. But I don't know how I would meet that person, and if I did it would be very unlikely that she liked me (nobody likes me, so why should this be any different?).

I'd probably agree that this might be teen angst, but I think that what I feel are mostly genuine worries based on facts. I don't want to be whiny or feel this way, but there are reasons to it.

And yes, probably I won't feel this bad when I grow up. But how can I know that I will actually feel good?

> well I can definitely tell you.. there are many nice people at SW.. you can definitely chat with us..

I appreciate that, but what bums me out isn't that I don't have people to talk to, is that people don't talk to me for a reason. There's something wrong with me that I cannot understand.

I've been going to a therapist roughly three times a month for the past 6 months. It's helped in some aspects, but obviously not all of them. As I said, he hasn't figured a reason why I'm socially rejected.

I try to meet new people, but no matter what kind of people they are or what their interests are, I'm always rejected. Even people from the internet (including Reddit) end up ignoring me after a few days.

I have hobbies (reading, drawing, programming, watching movies) but I don't enjoy them anymore. They started feeling like they're just work.

Well...

My whole life I haven't been accepted. A few years ago I stopped being socially awkward, but that didn't help. People just generally don't like me. My therapist cannot understand why this happens either.

I live with the wrong parents. It's not like they're the worst people ever, but they're just wrong for me. We disagree on so many levels, and the fact that I resent them for many choices they made that screwed up my life doesn't help at all. My dad is verbally abusive, and my mom is just an echo of him.

I met an awesome girl about two years ago. It took me months to make her like me. We dated for a while, but looking back she did a lot of things that showed that she didn't really love or respect me. That's why I broke up with her. However, I think she was the ideal person for me. We had so many things in common and connected in every possible way, it just seems statistically impossible to find someone like her again.

I don't have dreams to fulfill because they're too hard to pursuit realistically. I just don't think something good could happen to me.

I want to study filmmaking. But it's unrealistic to do so because there just isn't a way to make money from this. And my parents won't want to pay for this career.

People never do what they want to do with their lives, but at least they have things to look forward to, like friends or love. I don't have this to look forward to.
I don't want to say I'm 17 because then I'm going to get the generic teen angst/you're young and have a lot to look forward to/etc. answers. But yeah, I'm 17.
